thread:
sam: Heads up — deploybot flagged a p95 regression on /generate for the v2.5 rollout (USW). It suggested an auto-revert. Can someone with rollback authority confirm whether we let it run or we do a manual pin?
deploy-bot: ALERT: Canary p95 +28% vs baseline. Auto-revert threshold breached (p95_delta >= 20%). Suggested action: trigger-auto-rollback. [link: telemetry]
anya: I’m on call for the window. Before we hit auto-revert, what’s the customer-impact signal? Are errors increasing or just latency?
sam: Errors flat, just latency. A subset of traffic to a new kernel path. We saw KVcache miss rate spike too.
raj: If errors are flat, we might prefer a targeted traffic slice rollback vs full revert. Can we pin routing for embeddings only?
olivia: embeddings are affected most. We can flip routing for /embeddings to previous model binary (1.4.9) without touching chat endpoints.
anya: That seems safest. Manual partial rollback to embeddings route, then observe 2x p95 windows. If still bad, escalate to full revert.
oncall-bot: NOTE: Manual approval required to perform partial routing pin during change window (policy 3.2). Please ack.
sam: I approve partial pin for embeddings (manual). @raj @olivia can you action? 
raj: Doing it now. Command I’ll run: ```redwood route pin --service=embeddings --to-version=1.4.9 --scope=20pct --reason="canary p95 spike"```
raj: pinned 20% -> 100% over 3 mins, rolling back routing for embeddings to 1.4.9. Monitoring p95 and kvcache miss.
deploy-bot: ACTION: routing policy updated. New route applied: embeddings -> 1.4.9 (scope 100%).
olivia: p95 for embeddings dropped to baseline within 90s. KVcache miss back to normal.
anya: Good. No full revert needed. Sam — can you draft a short customer blurb about the partial rollback and that we saw no user-facing errors? I’ll prepare release-note addendum.
sam: Drafted: "During a canary rollout we observed increased latency for embeddings-only traffic; we rolled back embeddings routing to the previous stable binary (v1.4.9) for all regions. No errors observed and overall service impact was minimal. Engineering is investigating kernel path mismatch causing KVcache miss." Thoughts?
olivia: looks fine. Add follow-up line: "We are pausing further rollout until a fix is validated in staging"
sam: Added. Sending to #release-notes and to customer success. Closing thread unless anyone objects. :thumbsup:
anya: :thumbsup: closing from my side.
oncall-bot: INCIDENT-CLOSE: action completed and documented.
